Keep the FIRST picture's eight long legs, two body parts, markings, pose, web, fly/prey state, background, camera and fullsize landscape composition. Do not copy any scene content from the reference except the 8-eye design. Bold clean flat 2D illustration, no labels or text, no inset. Return the complete corrected first picture.
